# Sleep Medicine Research

> > An open-access, peer-reviewed journal publishing original research in sleep medicine with platinum open-access policy and comprehensive editorial oversight.

Sleep Medicine Research is a peer-reviewed academic journal affiliated with the Korean Society of Sleep Medicine and based in Seoul. The journal provides free access to all published articles and maintains rigorous publication ethics standards aligned with COPE guidelines.
